denylist_note: Events has no operator denylist yet. connpass is excluded at the SOURCE level (decision D1: its ToS forbids non-API automation and the only session available is Dais's personal account DaisNar), not by denylist string.
auto_rsvp_note: OFF until TODO #10 lands the model's QUALIFY judgment. The deterministic screen can prove free / in-person / in-region / open; it cannot judge whether an event is worth attending, and a loop that registers for everything free in Tokyo is a nuisance, not an agent. While this is false the daily pass discovers, screens and reports, and scripts/outbound-luma-rsvp.js is what actually registers.
notes: v1 is Luma only. Confirmation mail lands in the operator mailbox (LM_OUTBOUND_EMAIL); the identity is read from the environment, never committed here. LT (speaking) slots outrank plain attendance; that judgment is made by the model reading the event body, never by a regex.
